text: I have a vitacare handheld wand from Cosan. It .... I have a vitacare handheld wand from Cosan. It has a lot of pressure power. This holder was a bit large for the wand and although it fits in the holder, it always turns and sprays the door because it doesn’t hold it secure enough so that it doesn’t move inside the holder. I will try to wedge something in there to see if that helps
